description: Source code for a macOS ViewController managing a WKWebView, handling web content loading, cache clearing, server start events, download handling, and script messaging within the Focalboard application.

classes.name: ViewController
classes.description: A macOS view controller managing a WKWebView, handling web navigation, user interactions, server events, and messaging.

methods.name: viewDidLoad
methods.description: Initial setup when view loads, including web view configuration and server start check.

methods.name: viewDidAppear
methods.description: Sets focus to the web view when the view appears.

methods.name: onServerStarted
methods.description: Handles server start event, updates session and loads homepage.

methods.name: updateSessionTokenAndUserSettings
methods.description: Injects session token and user settings into web view via scripts.

methods.name: loadHomepage
methods.description: Loads the application's homepage in the web view.

methods.name: webView(_:runOpenPanelWith:initiatedByFrame:completionHandler:)
methods.description: Handles file open dialogs triggered from web content.

methods.name: webView(_:decidePolicyFor:preferences:decisionHandler:)
methods.description: Decides whether to download or allow navigation based on response.

methods.name: webView(_:decidePolicyFor:decisionHandler:)
methods.description: Decides whether to allow or download based on MIME type.

methods.name: webView(_:didFinish:)
methods.description: Handles actions after web content finishes loading, including UI adjustments and refresh hack.

methods.name: refreshWebView
methods.description: Temporary workaround to fix rendering artifacts.

methods.name: webView(_:didFailProvisionalNavigation:withError:)
methods.description: Handles navigation failure, retries loading if not loaded.

methods.name: webView(_:didFail:withError:)
methods.description: Handles navigation failure, makes web view visible.

methods.name: webView(_:createWebViewWith:for:windowFeatures:)
methods.description: Handles target=_blank links by opening in default browser.

methods.name: userContentController(_:didReceive:)
methods.description: Processes messages from web content, updating user settings.
